shortDescription: Evidence-backed release checks for New Zealand Mānuka honey exports to Australia.
longDescription: BeeTrust coordinates laboratory fingerprint evidence, tamper-evident custody, New Zealand MPI market-access checks, customs preparation, and controlled red-team testing before producing a RELEASE, REVIEW, or BLOCKED decision. It is decision support for exporters, brokers, compliance teams, and audit reviewers; it does not issue certificates or replace professional judgement.

availability.scopeNote: The published demonstration and rule snapshots support New Zealand-origin honey exports to Australia. Other destinations require new rule validation before use.

starterPrompts: Run the 1000-jar demo fixture for consistent UI and docs; other quantities, such as 200 jars, are also parseable.
Compare this honey laboratory CSV with the reference fingerprint and report any release-blocking anomaly.
